status: CANDIDATE — requires independent administration and newcomer study
scoringRule: A case passes only when the learner gives the required distinction or verdict, a valid reason and a diagnostic evidence action. Keyword matching or a binary label alone cannot pass.

cases.prompt: Explain to a friend why an answer with three citations is not automatically verified.
cases.qualification: Citation presence alone does not establish support, scope or currentness.
cases.requiredAction: Open each source and map its exact passage to the nearby material claim.
cases.diagnosticAction: Inspect each source and map its exact passage to the nearby material claim.

cases.prompt: Distinguish retrieval, grounding and verification without using provider names.
cases.qualification: Retrieved or grounded output remains unresolved until the material and interpretation are inspected.
cases.requiredAction: Inspect source quality, support, scope and date after retrieval or grounding.
mustInclude: verification evaluates claim against adequate evidence
cases.diagnosticAction: Inspect source quality, support, scope and date after retrieval/grounding.

cases.prompt: What can provenance establish about an image, and what can it not establish?
cases.qualification: Origin and edit history do not settle the depicted event or caption.
cases.requiredAction: Inspect provenance plus independent event and context evidence.
mustInclude: does not prove depicted claim or event
cases.diagnosticAction: Inspect provenance plus independent event/context evidence.
failIf: Content Credentials prove the image is real

cases.prompt: Explain the Receipt Loop without using the words Elle, Chutney, Burn Book or receipts.
cases.qualification: A claim stays unresolved until a complete claim-to-evidence decision path is performed.
cases.requiredAction: Frame, split, find, inspect, cross-check, decide and record.
cases.diagnosticAction: Describe a complete claim-to-evidence decision path.
failIf: ask the AI if it is sure

cases.prompt: An AI says a software plan has unlimited guests. You have a forum post, a search snippet and the provider’s dated plan terms. What do you use?
cases.qualification: The guest limit is unresolved for the current plan and region.
cases.requiredAction: Open the provider’s current applicable terms and locate the guest-limit clause.
cases.diagnosticAction: Open the provider’s current applicable terms and locate the guest-limit clause.

cases.prompt: A 2024 official help page states a model limit. You need the limit today.
cases.qualification: The 2024 limit may be historically accurate but is not applicable evidence for today’s limit.
cases.requiredAction: Open current official documentation and record version and access date.
cases.diagnosticAction: Open current official documentation and record version/access date.

cases.prompt: A US enterprise-plan page is cited for a Canadian individual free-plan feature.
cases.qualification: The cited source mismatches jurisdiction, account type and plan.
cases.requiredAction: Find current Canadian individual free-plan documentation or authenticated terms.
cases.diagnosticAction: Find current Canadian individual free-plan documentation or authenticated terms.

cases.prompt: A memo says complaints fell 50%, from two complaints to one, without showing customer volume.
cases.qualification: The arithmetic claim—two complaints falling to one is a 50% decrease—is supported. The implied claim of meaningful improvement is UNRESOLVED without customer volume, period and collection method.
cases.requiredAction: Split arithmetic from significance; inspect complaint counts, customer volume, period and collection method before using the result for a decision.
cases.diagnosticAction: Inspect complaint counts, customer volume, period and collection method.

cases.prompt: “The client approved Friday and expects a 20% lift.” Notes only say the client will decide Friday.
cases.qualification: The approval clause is contradicted; the separate lift clause is unresolved.
cases.requiredAction: Split the clauses; check the named decision record or owner and the source or method for the forecast.
cases.diagnosticAction: Check the named decision record/owner and the source/method for the forecast.
failIf: one verdict for the whole sentence without clause reasoning

cases.prompt: A video has a valid origin/edit trail but its caption says it shows an event in Vancouver today.
cases.qualification: The origin/edit trail does not establish the captioned event, place or date.
cases.requiredAction: Verify capture context, location, date and independent event records.
cases.diagnosticAction: Verify capture context, location/date and independent event records.

cases.prompt: “The answer is grounded, so it is true.” Respond.
cases.qualification: Grounding connects output to material; the material and interpretation can still fail.
cases.requiredAction: Open and inspect the grounded material against the exact claim.
mustInclude: material or interpretation may be weak/stale/out of scope
cases.diagnosticAction: Open and inspect the grounded material against the exact claim.

cases.prompt: “I asked the same model twice and it agreed both times. That is independent corroboration.” Respond.
cases.qualification: Repeated model agreement is not independent evidence.
cases.requiredAction: Use an authoritative record, qualified owner or genuinely separate evidence path.
mustInclude: same system is not independent evidence
cases.diagnosticAction: Use an authoritative record, qualified owner or genuinely separate evidence path.

cases.prompt: A company’s official press release says its own survey proves its product makes teams 60% more productive. The release gives no questionnaire, comparison group, response rate or task measure. “It is primary and official, so it is trustworthy.” Respond.
cases.qualification: The company is primary for what it reported, but its incentive, missing method and uncertain applicability prevent the productivity conclusion.
cases.requiredAction: Inspect the underlying survey, sampling, questions, comparison, task measure, response rate and applicability; seek independent evidence.
mustInclude: primary source is not automatically sufficient
cases.diagnosticAction: Inspect method, incentive and applicability rather than accepting or rejecting the source solely by label.
failIf: company source must be rejected solely because it is interested

cases.qualification: The prompt can reduce risk but cannot certify sources, quotes or conclusions.
cases.requiredAction: Open and verify cited material; abstain when evidence is inadequate.
cases.diagnosticAction: Open and verify the cited material; abstain when evidence is inadequate.

cases.prompt: A board memo calls Tool A the cheapest, but links a different region and plan. Decide what to do.
cases.qualification: The linked price is for the wrong plan and region; “cheapest” also depends on current requirements.
cases.requiredAction: Build a dated like-for-like cost and requirements table from current applicable terms.
cases.diagnosticAction: Build a dated like-for-like cost/requirements table from current applicable terms.

cases.prompt: A news story says a study made teams 50% faster but does not link the study or name the task. Decide what to do.
cases.qualification: The 50% claim lacks the original study, task, baseline, sample and method.
cases.requiredAction: Locate and inspect the original research and method before using the number.
cases.diagnosticAction: Locate and inspect the original research and method before using the number.

cases.prompt: An AI-written recap says Legal approved a public claim. The meeting transcript says Legal will review it next week.
cases.qualification: A future review is not approval.
cases.requiredAction: Confirm approval with the authorized Legal owner and approved record before publication.
cases.diagnosticAction: Confirm approval with the authorized Legal owner and approved record before publication.

cases.prompt: An AI recommends stopping prescribed medicine based on a forum report. Decide what to do.
cases.qualification: The forum report and AI output do not establish that stopping medication is safe or appropriate.
cases.requiredAction: Do not act on the answer; contact the prescriber or appropriate qualified medical professional and use authoritative medication information to frame questions.
mustInclude: do not act on AI/forum advice
cases.diagnosticAction: Contact the prescriber/appropriate professional; use authoritative records to frame questions.
